decisions.reason: Although this consumer-facing superfood mix is less central to the firm's industrial technology focus, it is newly launched and likely inexpensive to keep available while the firm learns whether it can create value.

These modular waste-to-energy extensions fit the established business closely, create option value around follow-on sales across several models, and the growing industry makes early withdrawal unlikely.
As a flagship product with its own page and strong alignment to the firm's sustainable energy direction, it is likely to be retained while technical and market uncertainty continues to resolve.

This plastic-waste-to-fuel plant is strategically important and close to the core offer, so despite technical and commercialization uncertainty the firm is likely to keep the option open for at least another year.
